title: SEBI just called GMP unreliable — PR No.75/2026 | IPO investors must watch #Shorts
description: SEBI issued PR No. 75/2026 on 23 November 2026 — officially calling Grey Market Premium (GMP) unofficial, unverified and unregulated. IPO investors across India have used GMP as a listing-price predictor for years. SEBI has now directed all registered intermediaries to stop publishing GMP data. If you rely on GMP before every IPO, this changes everything.
